name: a11y-react-fix-and-test
description: Applies each fix plan task in a React codebase one task at a time: writes a failing jest-axe or vitest-axe plus Testing Library test first, makes the smallest JSX change using native elements, `useRef` focus management and live regions, enables eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, and commits only when the test, the lint and the full suite pass.
